# paper-docx API reference

The complete public API of `docx` 0.2.0, generated from docstrings. The distribution is `paper-docx`, a fork of python-docx; the import name is `docx`. Both what the fork adds and the API it inherits from python-docx are documented here.

This index names every symbol documented here. Open the one page you need rather than reading them all.

## `docx.blocks`

Anchor-relative block operations and clause-level redlines (paper-docx).

Full contract: [blocks.md](blocks.md)

- `BlockEditResult` — Outcome of a block-level edit.
- `BlockTarget = Union[str, Block, Span]`
- `ListBlock` — A real bullet/decimal list (backed by a real numbering definition).
- `RichParagraph` — A paragraph built from styled runs.
- `TableBlock` — A simple rectangular table of plain-text cells.
- `TextRun` — One run of a rich paragraph.
- `check_install() -> None` — Refuse when paper-docx and python-docx are both installed.
- `insert_blocks_after(document, anchor, *, blocks, tracked=False, author=None, date=None) -> BlockEditResult` — Insert a typed block list after `anchor`, and return a `BlockEditResult`.
- `insert_section_after(document, anchor, *, heading, paragraphs, heading_style='Heading2', body_style=None, tracked=False, author=None, date=None) -> BlockEditResult` — Insert a heading plus body paragraphs after `anchor`, and return a `BlockEditResult`.
- `require_anchor_owner(document, anchor, *, argument='anchor') -> None` — Check ownership for live anchor forms; value/string anchors are inert.
- `rollback_on_error(document, *participants) -> Generator[None, None, None]` — Restore the live package and named mutable proxies after an error.
- `tracked_delete_paragraphs(document, start_anchor, *, end_anchor=None, count=1, author, date=None) -> BlockEditResult` — Mark a paragraph range deleted with real tracked changes; returns a `BlockEditResult`.
- `tracked_replace_paragraphs(document, start_anchor, replacement_paragraphs, *, end_anchor=None, count=1, body_style=None, author, date=None) -> BlockEditResult` — Tracked-delete a paragraph range and tracked-insert replacements after it.

## `docx.bookmarks`

Bookmark enumeration, creation, and deletion.

Full contract: [bookmarks.md](bookmarks.md)

- `BookmarkInfo` — One bookmark: its name, id, story, and the visible text it wraps.
- `DEL_TEXT = qn('w:delText')`
- `INSTR_TEXT = qn('w:instrText')`
- `check_install() -> None` — Refuse when paper-docx and python-docx are both installed.
- `create_bookmark(document, span, name) -> BookmarkInfo` — Bookmark exactly `span`'s text under `name`, and return its `BookmarkInfo`.
- `delete_bookmark(document, name) -> None` — Remove `name`'s markers, leaving the text in place.
- `is_direct_run_child(element) -> bool` — Whether ``element`` is a direct child of a ``w:r`` element.
- `list_bookmarks(document) -> 'List[BookmarkInfo]'` — Every bookmark across every story, in document order.
- `project_run_child(element) -> RunChildProjection` — Return the conservative text projection for a direct ``w:r`` child.
- `require_span_owner(document, span, *, argument='span') -> None` — Refuse a live span captured from a different document package.
- `rollback_on_error(document, *participants) -> Generator[None, None, None]` — Restore the live package and named mutable proxies after an error.

## `docx.commentops`

Comment thread operations: anchored text, replies, resolution.

Full contract: [commentops.md](commentops.md)

- `COMMENTS_EXTENDED_CONTENT_TYPE = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.commentsExtended+xml'`
- `COMMENTS_EXTENDED_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE = 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2011/relationships/commentsExtended'`
- `COMMENTS_EXTENSIBLE_CONTENT_TYPE = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.commentsExtensible+xml'`
- `COMMENTS_EXTENSIBLE_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE = 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2018/08/relationships/commentsExtensible'`
- `COMMENTS_IDS_CONTENT_TYPE = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.commentsIds+xml'`
- `COMMENTS_IDS_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE = 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2016/09/relationships/commentsIds'`
- `DEL_TEXT = qn('w:delText')`
- `INSTR_TEXT = qn('w:instrText')`
- `anchored_text(document, comment) -> str` — The document text `comment` is anchored to, taken from its range marks.
- `check_install() -> None` — Refuse when paper-docx and python-docx are both installed.
- `comment_thread(document) -> Tuple[dict, ...]` — Every comment with its thread state: id, author, text, resolved, parent id, and anchored
- `delete_comment(document, comment) -> None` — Delete `comment` and its replies, removing their range marks from the text.
- `is_direct_run_child(element) -> bool` — Whether ``element`` is a direct child of a ``w:r`` element.
- `is_resolved(document, comment) -> bool` — Whether `comment`'s thread is marked resolved.
- `parent_of(document, comment) -> Optional[int]` — The comment `comment` replies to, or None when it starts a thread.
- `project_run_child(element) -> RunChildProjection` — Return the conservative text projection for a direct ``w:r`` child.
- `reply(document, comment, text, *, author, initials=None, date=None) -> 'Comment'` — Add a threaded reply to `comment` and return the new `Comment`.
- `require_comment_owner(document, comment, *, argument='comment') -> None` — Refuse a comment proxy from another part and detect detached proxies.
- `resolve(document, comment, *, resolved=True) -> None` — Mark `comment`'s thread resolved, or reopen it with `resolved=False`.
- `rollback_on_error(document, *participants) -> Generator[None, None, None]` — Restore the live package and named mutable proxies after an error.

## `docx.errors`

Typed refusals for paper-docx safe-editing APIs.

Full contract: [errors.md](errors.md)

- `AmbiguousTargetError` — The target specification matches more than one location.
- `BoundaryViolationError` — The operation would cross a structural boundary it must respect.
- `DocumentProtectedError` — The document enforces an editing restriction this operation ignores.
- `MalformedPackageError` — The file is not a package this library can safely read.
- `PaperRefusal` — Base for every safe refusal raised by paper-docx APIs.
- `RelationshipPolicyError` — The operation would create or modify a package relationship unsafely.
- `TargetNotFoundError` — No location matches the target specification.
- `UnsupportedStructureError` — The target involves structure this operation does not safely support.
- `check_install() -> None` — Refuse when paper-docx and python-docx are both installed.

## `docx.fields`

Field authoring — formulas, never values.

- `add_page_count_field(paragraph) -> None` — Append a NUMPAGES field, typically to a footer paragraph.
- `add_page_number_field(paragraph) -> None` — Append a PAGE field, typically to a footer paragraph.
- `add_reference_field(paragraph, *, bookmark, kind='text') -> None` — Append a cross-reference to `bookmark`: its text (`kind="text"`), page (`"page"`), or
- `check_install() -> None` — Refuse when paper-docx and python-docx are both installed.

## `docx.package`

WordprocessingML Package class and related objects.

Full contract: [package.md](package.md)

- `CompareFinding` — One difference compare REPORTS instead of redlining (declared limit).
- `CompareResult` — The redlined document plus everything compare could not redline.
- `ImageParts` — Collection of `ImagePart` objects corresponding to images in the package.
- `Package` — Customizations specific to a WordprocessingML package.
- `PackageDiagnosis` — Typed triage for a file `docx.Document()` may refuse or crash on.
- `PackageDiff` — Part-by-part comparison of two OPC packages.
- `PartDiff` — One byte-changed part in a package comparison.
- `PatchSaveResult` — Outcome of a `patch_save` call.
- `StoryTextDiff`
- `TextDiff` — Per-story unified diffs of visible block text.
- `compare(original, revised, *, author, date=None, granularity='word', materialize=None) -> CompareResult` — A `CompareResult`: `original` plus tracked changes producing `revised`.
- `diagnose(path) -> PackageDiagnosis` — Why the file at `path` can or cannot be opened, as a `PackageDiagnosis`.
- `diff_package(path_a, path_b) -> PackageDiff` — Part-by-part diff of the OPC packages at `path_a` and `path_b`.
- `patch_save(original_path, document, out_path) -> PatchSaveResult` — Save `document` to `out_path`, restoring original bytes wherever possible.
- `pending_changes(path) -> TextDiff` — What the document's pending revisions would change if all were accepted.
- `text_diff(path_a, path_b, *, view='current') -> TextDiff` — What changed, textually, between the documents at `path_a` and `path_b`.
- `xml_equivalent(a, b) -> bool` — True when `a` and `b` are structurally identical XML documents.

- `replace_all(document, needle, new_text, *, story=None, view='current', match='exact', tracked=False, author=None, date=None, preserve_revision=False) -> ReplaceAllResult` — Replace every match of `needle` in one pass, and return a `ReplaceAllResult`.
